summary: Tested ZeroTier network monitoring integration for technical sites. All 12 backend tests passed. All frontend tests passed including: ZeroTier page navigation, config panel, sidebar limited navigation for technical sites, and site type selector in Create Main Site dialog.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ZeroTier monitoring integration fully functional. Technical site 'zt-monitor' exists with site_type='technical'. ZeroTier API integration uses real ZeroTier Central API (no mock) - member fetching will fail without valid ZT token as expected.

backend_passed: POST /api/main-sites creates technical site with site_type=technical
GET /api/main-sites/features includes zerotier in technical group
GET /api/zerotier/{main_site_id}/members fails with invalid ZT token
Technical site has team_settings and zerotier features
frontend_passed: ZeroTier page loads with 'ZeroTier Network Monitor' header
'Not Configured' state shows with Configure Now button
Config panel has API Token and Network ID inputs
Config panel has Save Configuration button
Sidebar for technical site has limited nav items (no Shows/Calendar)
Create Main Site dialog shows Site Type selector (Radio/Technical)
Selecting Technical type hides features checklist
Selecting Radio type shows features checklist
Technical badge displays on zt-monitor site card in Network Admin

notes: ZeroTier member fetching requires real ZeroTier Central API token. Without valid token, member/network endpoints correctly return 401. This is expected behavior, not a bug.
